decisive_spans.text: Transvaginal ultrasound demonstrated an 18 cm diameter ovarian tumor

Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis revealed a large, fluid-filled lesion measuring 19.3 × 6.2 × 21 cm, located in the pelvis and mid-abdomen, displacing the uterus and compressing the aorta and inferior vena cava

response.rationale: D4 is a general diagnosis that is well supported by the imaging findings of a large ovarian tumor. D2, Serous cystadenoma, is also well supported, but the HE4 level is slightly elevated, which could be a minor contradiction for a purely benign serous cystadenoma. Given the information, D4 is a more encompassing and safer choice without any contradictions.
